Runs solfuzz Protobuf fixtures in single-threaded or tile-based parallel mode.

# Purpose
`test_sol_compat.c` is a test runner for `solfuzz/sol_compat/protosol` Protobuf fixtures. It scans one file or a directory tree, finds files with the `.fix` suffix, and dispatches each file to the correct fixture handler based on the path name, such as `fd_solfuzz_instr_fixture`, `fd_solfuzz_txn_fixture`, `fd_solfuzz_elf_loader_fixture`, `fd_solfuzz_syscall_fixture`, `fd_solfuzz_vm_interp_fixture`, and `fd_solfuzz_block_fixture`. The file reads each fixture into memory, runs the test, and logs success or failure. It also checks that the scratchpad allocator state is restored after each test.

The file supports two execution modes. In single-threaded mode, it walks the file system and runs tests in sequence. In multi-threaded mode, one tile walks the directory tree and publishes file paths into `mcache` and `dcache`, while worker tiles read those paths and execute tests in parallel. The [`main`](<#main>) function sets up the Firedancer workspace, creates one `fd_solfuzz_runner_t` per worker, builds the shared caches and flow-sequence objects, and then selects the execution mode. It also supports command-line options for page size, page count, workspace reuse, workspace seed, workspace tag, and fail-fast behavior.
